title: Phytochemical composition comprising Ocimum sanctum and Tinospora cordifolia for immune stimulation
text: A synergistic immunomodulatory preparation comprising standardized polysaccharide fractions of Tinospora cordifolia (Guduchi) and ursolic acid fractions of Ocimum sanctum (Tulsi), stimulating macrophage phagocytosis and NK-cell activity.
